title: Authorize Advance Payment
name: advance-payment-authorize
description:
Authorize an Advance Payment. Only allowed for status New (1) or Waiting For Approval (38). User must have authorization access. If approval flow is configured and user is not the final approver, status changes to "Waiting For Approval" (38). If user is the final approver or no approval flow exists, status changes to "Authorized" (3). When fully authorized, release payment journal is created automatically if user has release access.

Base URL Staging: https://stg7.esb.co.id/core-stg
Base URL Production: https://services.esb.co.id/core

Header.description: Bearer {Access Token}. Access Token can get from response API Login

title: Create Advance Payment
name: advance-payment-create
description:
Create a new Advance Payment. The advancePaymentNum (prefix: AP) is auto-generated. Status will be set to "New" (1). If approval flow is configured, status may change to "Waiting For Approval" (38) or auto-authorize to "Authorized" (3).

Base URL Staging INT: https://stg7.esb.co.id/core-int
Base URL Staging: https://stg7.esb.co.id/core-stg
Base URL Production: https://services.esb.co.id/core

Header.description: Bearer {Access Token}. Access Token can get from response API Login

body.description: Required. Advance Payment Date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Binding: required,datetime=2006-01-02
Required. Branch ID. Must be >= 0 and exist in database. Binding: required,number,gte=0. Validate: exist_in_db
Required. Supplier ID. Must be >= 0 and exist in database. Binding: required,number,gte=0. Validate: exist_in_db
Required. COA Number. Max 20 characters. Must exist in database. Binding: required,not_emoji,max=20. Validate: exist_in_db
Required. Currency ID. Must be >= 0 and exist in database. Binding: required,number,gte=0. Validate: exist_in_db
Required. Exchange Rate. Must be >= 0. If IDR currency (currencyID=1), rate must equal 1. Binding: required,number,gte=0. Validate: idr_currency_rate
Supplier Invoice Number. Max 20 characters. ASCII only (nullable). Binding: omitempty,ascii,max=20
Bank Name. Max 50 characters. ASCII only. Binding: omitempty,ascii,max=50
Bank Account Number. Max 500 characters. ASCII only. Binding: omitempty,ascii,max=500
Bank Account Name. Max 100 characters. ASCII only. Binding: omitempty,ascii,max=100
Bank Fee COA Number. Max 20 characters. Must exist in database if provided (nullable). Binding: omitempty,not_emoji,max=20. Validate: omitempty,exist_in_db
Bank Fee Amount. Must be >= 0. Binding: number,decimal=20;4,gte=0

Purchase Order Number reference. Max 20 characters. ASCII only. Currency and supplier must match (nullable). Binding: omitempty,ascii,max=20. Validate: omitempty,reference_currency_equal,reference_supplier_equal
Required. Advance Payment Total. Must be > 0. Binding: number,decimal=20;4,gt=0
VAT Total. Binding: number,decimal=20;4
Additional Information. Max 1000 characters. ASCII only. Binding: omitempty,ascii,max=1000
Other cost line items. Binding: omitempty,dive
Required (in costs). COA Number for cost. Max 20 characters. Must exist in database. Binding: required,not_emoji,max=20. Validate: exist_in_db
Cost Amount. Binding: number,decimal=20;4
Cost Notes. Max 200 characters. ASCII only (nullable). Binding: omitempty,ascii,max=200

title: Create Employee Advance Payment
name: employee-advance-payment-create
description:
Create a new employee advance payment. The advance number (prefix: EA) is auto-generated. Status will be set to "New" (1). If the user has form authorization access, the record is automatically authorized to status "Authorized" (3) upon creation.

Base URL Staging INT: https://stg7.esb.co.id/core-int
Base URL Staging: https://stg7.esb.co.id/core-stg
Base URL Production: https://services.esb.co.id/core

Header.description: Bearer {Access Token}. Access Token can get from response API Login

body.description: Required. Advance payment date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Binding: required,date=Y-m-d
Number of days until due. Must be 0–999. Binding: number,gte=0,lte=999
Required. Employee code. Max 50 characters, no emojis, must exist in DB and be active. Binding: required,max=50,not_emoji. Validate: exist_in_db
Required. Branch ID. Must be >= 1, must exist in DB, user must have branch access. Binding: required,number,gte=1. Validate: exist_in_db
Required. Chart of account number. Max 20 characters, no emojis, must exist in DB as a Bank or Cash account. Binding: required,max=20,not_emoji. Validate: exist_in_db
Required. Currency ID. Must be >= 1, must exist in DB and be active. Binding: required,number,gte=1. Validate: exist_in_db
Required. Exchange rate. Must be >= 1, max decimal(20;4). IDR currency must have rate = 1. Binding: required,number,gte=1,decimal=20;4. Validate: idr_currency_rate
Required. Advance total amount. Must be >= 1, max decimal(20;4). Binding: required,number,gte=1,decimal=20;4
Additional information. Max 1000 characters, no emojis. Binding: max=1000,not_emoji

description:

Base URL Staging INT: https://stg7.esb.co.id/core-int
Base URL Staging: https://stg7.esb.co.id/core-stg
Base URL Production: https://services.esb.co.id/core

body.description: Required. Advance payment date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Binding: required,date=Y-m-d
Number of days until due. Must be 0–999. Binding: number,gte=0,lte=999
Required. Employee code. Max 50 characters, no emojis, must exist in DB and be active. Binding: required,max=50,not_emoji. Validate: exist_in_db
Required. Branch ID. Must be >= 1, must exist in DB, user must have branch access. Binding: required,number,gte=1. Validate: exist_in_db
Required. Chart of account number. Max 20 characters, no emojis, must exist in DB as a Bank or Cash account. Binding: required,max=20,not_emoji. Validate: exist_in_db
Required. Currency ID. Must be >= 1, must exist in DB and be active. Binding: required,number,gte=1. Validate: exist_in_db
Required. Exchange rate. Must be >= 1, max decimal(20;4). IDR currency must have rate = 1. Binding: required,number,gte=1,decimal=20;4. Validate: idr_currency_rate
Required. Advance total amount. Must be >= 1, max decimal(20;4). Binding: required,number,gte=1,decimal=20;4
Additional information. Max 1000 characters, no emojis. Binding: max=1000,not_emoji

name: employee-advance-payment-upload
description:
Bulk import employee advance payments from an Excel file (.xlsx). Max file size: 2MB. Returns the total number of successfully created records, or an error Excel file with row-level validation details.

Excel sheet name: Employee Advance Payment
Excel columns (row 2 = header, data starts from row 3): Column A: Sequence | Column B: Employee Code (required, max 50, must exist and be active) | Column C: Employee Name (required, max 100, must match Employee Code) | Column D: Branch Name (required, must exist and be active, user must have access) | Column E: Employee Advance Date (required, format dd/mm/yyyy, must be >= end period) | Column F: Currency (required, must exist and be active) | Column G: Rate (required, numeric, > 0, max decimal(20;4)) | Column H: Return Due Date (required, format dd/mm/yyyy, must be >= Employee Advance Date) | Column I: Account (required, must be a valid Bank or Cash CoA) | Column J: Employee Advance Total (required, numeric, > 0, max decimal(20;4)) | Column K: Additional Info (optional, max 1000 characters, no emojis)
Base URL Staging INT: https://stg7.esb.co.id/core-int

Filter to limit shown data per page, the default value is 20

Filter Sort, Can be filled with:
- 1: goodsReceiptNum
- 2: refNum
- 3: transType
- 4: additionalInfo
- 5: branchID
- 6: locationID
- 7: statusID
- 8: createdBy
- 9: sourceName
Can use "-" to sort data descending example: -statusID
Filter minimum Goods Receipt date. Format: yyyy-mm-dd
Filter maximum Goods Receipt date. Format: yyyy-mm-dd
Filter Reference Number, can be filled with Goods Delivery Number, Purchase Order Number, Product Sales Return Number

Filter Transaction Type, can be filled with:
- 1: Purchase Order
- 2: Goods Delivery
- 3: Product Sales Return

Filter Status ID , Can be filled with:
- 1: New
-2: Rejected
- 3: Authorized
- 11: Invoice
- 33: Pending
- 39: Full Returned
- 45: Partially Returned
If want to show all data can disable this params

Filter Source Name, Can be filled with
- 1: Supplier Name if transType = Purchase Order
- 2 : Origin Location if transType = Goods Delivery
- 3 : Customer Name if transType = Product Sales Return

title: Create Item Journal
name: create-item-journal
description:
API to create Item Journal (Template or Non-Template)
Important:
• If requestTemplateID is provided, the item journal will be created as "with template"
• If requestTemplateID is not provided (null), the item journal will be created as "non-template"
• Template Validation: When using a template, all productDetailID in itemJournalDetails must exist in the specified request template

Base URL Staging INT: https://stg7.esb.co.id/core-int
Base URL Staging: https://stg7.esb.co.id/core-stg
Base URL Production: https://services.esb.co.id/core

Header.description: Bearer {Access Token}. Access Token can be obtained from Login API response

Body Parameter.description: Item Journal Date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD, Example: 2025-12-10 (required, ASCII only)
Branch ID (required, must be valid branch ID from database and user must have access to this branch)
Location ID (required, must be valid location ID from database, must be registered in the specified branch, and must be type warehouse or kitchen)

Document Template ID (optional, must be valid request template ID from database if provided)
Template Mode (When Provided):
• Item journal will be created as "with template"
• All productDetailID in itemJournalDetails must exist in the specified template
• Products are restricted to those defined in the template

Non-Template Mode (When Not Provided/Null):
• Item journal will be created as "non-template"
• No template validation for products
• Any valid product can be used
Additional Information (optional, ASCII only, max 1000 characters)
Array of item journal detail objects (required, minimum 1 item, ProductDetailID must be unique within array)
Item Journal Detail ID (optional, for update operations)

title: Update Item Journal
name: update-item-journal
description:
API to update Item Journal (Template or Non-Template)
Important:
• The API allows updating existing item journals that are in New or Rejected status
• For Authorized item journals, update is only allowed if user has access to item-journal approval feature
• If requestTemplateID is provided, the item journal will be updated as "with template"
• If requestTemplateID is not provided (null), the item journal will be updated as "non-template"
• Template Validation: When using a template, all productDetailID in itemJournalDetails must exist in the specified request template
• Stock Validation: Cannot update authorized item journals if the stock has been used in other transactions

Base URL Staging INT: https://stg7.esb.co.id/core-int
Base URL Staging: https://stg7.esb.co.id/core-stg
Base URL Production: https://services.esb.co.id/core

Header.description: Bearer {Access Token}. Access Token can be obtained from Login API response

Path Parameter.description: Item Journal Number (required, ASCII only, max 100 characters)

Body Parameter.description: Item Journal Date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD, Example: 2025-12-10 (required, ASCII only)
Branch ID (required, must be valid branch ID from database and user must have access to this branch)
Location ID (required, must be valid location ID from database, must be registered in the specified branch, and must be type warehouse or kitchen)

Document Template ID (optional, must be valid request template ID from database if provided)
Template Mode (When Provided):
• Item journal will be updated as "with template"
• All productDetailID in itemJournalDetails must exist in the specified template
• Products are restricted to those defined in the template

Non-Template Mode (When Not Provided/Null):
• Item journal will be updated as "non-template"
• No template validation for products
• Any valid product can be used
Additional Information (optional, ASCII only, max 1000 characters)
Array of item journal detail objects (required, minimum 1 item, ProductDetailID must be unique within array)
Item Journal Detail ID (required for existing details, -1 for new details)

Product Detail ID (required, must be valid product detail ID from database)
Template Mode: Must exist in the specified request template
Non-Template Mode: No template validation required
Purpose ID (optional, must be valid purpose ID from database if provided, required if user has access to purpose required feature)
Product Quantity (required, decimal number, can be positive or negative)
Product HPP (Cost of Goods Sold) (optional, decimal number, must be greater than or equal to 0)

title: Authorize Memorial Journal
name: memorial-journal-authorize
description:
Authorize a memorial journal. Only allowed for status New (1) or Waiting For Approval (38). User must have authorization access. If approval flow is configured and user is not the final approver, status changes to "Waiting For Approval" (38). If user is the final approver or no approval flow, status changes to "Authorized" (3) and GL journal entries are created. Cannot authorize future-dated transactions (if setting "Transaction > Future Date" is enabled).

title: Create Memorial Journal
name: memorial-journal-create
description:
Create a new memorial journal. The memorial journal number (prefix: MJ) is auto-generated. Requires minimum 2 detail lines. Status will be set to "New" (1). If approval flow is configured, status may change to "Waiting For Approval" (38) or auto-authorize to "Authorized" (3).

Base URL Staging INT: https://stg7.esb.co.id/core-int
Base URL Staging: https://stg7.esb.co.id/core-stg
Base URL Production: https://services.esb.co.id/core

Header.description: Bearer {Access Token}. Access Token can get from response API Login

body.description: Required. Transaction date. Format: YYYY-MM-DD. Must not exceed close period
Additional info. ASCII only, max 1000 characters
Required. Detail line items. Minimum 2 items
Detail ID (0 or omit for new lines)
Required. Branch ID. Must exist and user must have access
Cost Center ID. Must exist and user must have access (nullable)
Project ID. Must exist in database (nullable)
Required. Chart of Account number. Must exist and be level 4
Notes. ASCII only, max 100 characters
Required. Currency ID. Must exist in database
Currency exchange rate. Must be >= 0. IDR currency must be 1
Debit amount. Required if crAmount is empty. Must be >= 0
Credit amount. Required if drAmount is empty. Must be >= 0

examples.title: Example usage:
examples.content:
curl --location --request POST '{{base_url}}/accounting/memorial-journal' \
--header 'Authorization: Bearer {{access_token}}' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data-raw '{
    "memorialJournalDate": "2025-01-15",
    "additionalInfo": "Monthly office rent adjustment",
    "memorialJournalDetails": [
        {
            "branchID": 74,
            "costCenterID": 1,
            "coaNo": "6 1 01 01",
            "notes": "Rent expense",
            "currencyID": 1,
            "rate": 1,
            "drAmount": 5000000,
            "crAmount": 0
        },
        {
            "branchID": 74,
            "costCenterID": 1,
            "coaNo": "1 1 01 01",
            "notes": "Cash payment",
            "currencyID": 1,
            "rate": 1,
            "drAmount": 0,
            "crAmount": 5000000
        }
    ]
}'

title: Create Purchase Invoice

description:
API to create a new purchase invoice

Base URL Staging: https://stg7.esb.co.id/core-stg

Request Body.description: Purchase Invoice Date (required, format: yyyy-mm-dd)
Supplier ID (required, numeric, >= 1)
Supplier Invoice Number (optional, ASCII, max 50 chars)
Currency ID (required, numeric, >= 1)
Exchange Rate (required, numeric, > 0)
VAT Invoice Number (optional, ASCII, max 50 chars)
Due Days (numeric, 0-999)
Purchase Invoice Due Date (required, format: yyyy-mm-dd)
Additional Information (optional, ASCII, max 1000 chars)
Reference Total Amount (numeric, decimal up to 20 digits with 4 decimals)
Cost Total Amount (numeric, decimal up to 20 digits with 4 decimals)
Invoice Total Amount (numeric, decimal up to 20 digits with 4 decimals)
List of Additional Costs (optional)
Cost ID (optional, numeric, >= -1)
Chart of Account Number (required, ASCII, max 20 chars)
Cost Amount (numeric, decimal up to 20 digits with 4 decimals)
List of Invoice Details (required, minimum 1 item)
Discount Amount (numeric, decimal up to 20 digits with 4 decimals)
Discount Percent (numeric, decimal up to 20 digits with 4 decimals, 0-100)
Detail ID (optional, numeric, >= -1)
Purchase Order Discount (numeric, decimal up to 20 digits with 4 decimals)
Purchase Order Price (numeric, decimal up to 20 digits with 4 decimals)
Unit Price (numeric, decimal up to 20 digits with 4 decimals)
Luxury Item Flag (required, numeric, 0 or 1, must match product's luxury flag)
Product Detail ID (required, numeric, >= 1)
Quantity (numeric, decimal up to 20 digits with 4 decimals)
Goods Quantity (numeric, decimal up to 20 digits with 4 decimals)
Reference Number (required, ASCII, max 20 chars)
Tax ID (optional, numeric, >= 1)
Tax Rate (optional, numeric, decimal up to 20 digits with 4 decimals)
VAT Total Amount (numeric, decimal up to 20 digits with 4 decimals)
VAT Value (numeric, decimal up to 20 digits with 4 decimals)

Body Response.description: Date and time when the API was requested

title: Upload Simple Transfer Attachment
name: upload-simple-transfer-attachment
description:
Api to upload Simple Transfer Attachment

Base URL Staging INT: https://stg7.esb.co.id/core-int
Base URL Staging: https://stg7.esb.co.id/core-stg
Base URL Production: https://services.esb.co.id/core

Header.description: Bearer {Access Token}. Access Token can be get from response API Login
multipart/form-data

Body Data-Form.description: File to upload attachment for simpleTransfery, index can be filled with increment of number that depend on how many file that will attached, the number will start from 0. Data Type allowed "pdf", "bmp", "gif", "jpg", "jpeg", "jpe", "png"

Url of existing attachment for simpleTransfer that can be viewed from API View simpleTransfer, index can be filled with increment of number that depend on how many file that already attached, the number will start from 0. If there are already attachment but this data not included then the existing attachment will removed

Body Response.description: Object value to describe URL where attachment saved
